_README: THE ONE CONFIG. This single file drives the whole instance: it COMPILES (via server/render.py) into the CEO's CLAUDE.md, the CEO persona (agents/CEO.md), the worker personas (.claude/agents/*.md), the business-context rules (.claude/rules/*.md), the per-department skills (skills/run-dept-*/SKILL.md), and the MCP wiring (.mcp.json). It does NOT parametrize a frozen machine — the render step code-generates the system from this. The frontend config-settings panel reads/writes this file (business + departments) and .secrets/mcp_state.json (keys); on save it re-runs render. Secrets are NEVER here — they live in .secrets/mcp_state.json (agent-invisible). This is the EXAMPLE shipped with the base; an instance's live file is config.json. Unknowns are null and listed under _needs_from_client — never fabricate a value.

company.name: Example Co
company.mission: One sentence: what this company exists to do.
company.context: Business context in markdown. Who the company is, what it sells, the ICP in prose, the voice, the guardrails. The CEO and every worker read this (it renders into CLAUDE.md + a business-context rule). Keep it concrete.
company.scope_rules: Hard guardrails the whole company must obey (e.g. 'never contact these named accounts — they are handled manually; dedupe against them before every send'). Rendered into a rules file loaded globally.

_runtime_options: tmux-anthropic = interactive `claude` in tmux on Anthropic (jobworld_agent). sdk-minimax = headless claude_agent_sdk on MiniMax-M3 with Anthropic/OAuth fallback (p_main_agent). Frontend-selectable; both consume the SAME rendered layout — only the CEO launcher differs.

targeting.notes: Prose ICP: who to target and who NOT to.

departments.name: outreach
departments.purpose: Run cold campaigns via Instantly. From-name, sending domains, warmup and tracked links are configured INSIDE the Instantly workspace — not here.

copy.positioning: The offer/positioning the copy leads with.
copy.cta: The call to action (e.g. a booking link).

_mcp_note: type selects the server template in server/render.py (RENDER_MCP_TEMPLATES). secret_ref names the block in .secrets/mcp_state.json whose values render injects into the server's env. The key never appears in config or in any prompt.

_needs_from_client.instantly.INSTANTLY_API_KEY: API key of the warmed Instantly workspace. From-name / sending domains / warmup / tracked links are all set IN Instantly, not in this config.
_needs_from_client.apollo.APOLLO_API_KEY: Apollo API key for lead search.
_needs_from_client.outreach.compliance.postal_address: CAN-SPAM physical mailing address (or confirm Instantly injects it).
_needs_from_client.outreach.compliance.unsubscribe_url: Working unsubscribe link (or confirm Instantly injects it).
